title: Universal Type-I Interface Operator / Boundary Kernel
factorization: Archetype × PrimitiveKernel × VolumetricKernel × InterfaceOperator × ProcessSequence × StateHistory × Evidence
assembly_form: Stack={regions V_i, interfaces Γ_ij, domain kernels K_i, interface operators J_ij, process DAG P, state z(t), evidence E}; each interface contributes only its declared domain-valid jump/continuity relation and residual.
rules: Interface operators are reusable boundary primitives, not new component archetypes or duplicated recipes.
X→Y formation/process validity never implies Y→X.
NUMERIC_IF requires attributable geometry/material/process/state inputs and a valid model regime; otherwise retain SYMBOLIC/HOLD.
Closed-form capacitance/contact/thermal/fluid/optical/RF relations are used only when their assumptions are satisfied; arbitrary 3D fields use the corresponding volumetric/solver route.
No interface operator creates breakdown, withstand, lifetime, hermeticity, pressure rating, PL/SIL, certification, physical execution or release authority.
Exact CGXI/passport/process/tool/calibration/test evidence overrides generic interface assumptions.

records.Conjugate State / Potential: electric potential V / electrochemical potential where applicable
records.Boundary / Jump Law: ΔV = I·Rc for lumped ohmic contact when Rc is valid; otherwise solve conductor/contact field with continuity of charge/current
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: contact resistance or contact resistivity; material pair; contact area/pressure; surface state; T; frequency if consequential
records.Geometry / Orientation: contact face/overlap/via/terminal geometry; local normal and current path
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: form/clean/activate contact before encapsulation; X→Y requires successor process to preserve contact surface and geometry
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: later cure/oxidation/contamination/strain must not raise Rc beyond declared envelope; preserve inspectable/testable path
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF Rc/contact resistivity and geometry/state are attributable or measured; source-typical value alone does not qualify exact contact
records.Verification / Falsifier: 4-wire/contact resistance, continuity, thermal-rise and cycle test; falsify on drift/open/hotspot
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: explicit contact FE/field solve or measured multiport model when lumped Rc is invalid
records.Notes: A printed conductor touching another layer is not automatically an ideal node.

records.Transferred Flux / Quantity: displacement/charge Q,D and leakage J where modelled
records.Boundary / Jump Law: Maxwell boundary conditions: tangential E continuity absent singular source; normal D jump = free surface charge. Closed-form C only when topology assumptions hold; arbitrary 3D uses Q_i=ΣC_ijV_j
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: ε tensor/εr(f,T,RH), conductivity/loss if relevant; exact dielectric/conductor geometry; interfaces/voids; boundary potentials
records.Geometry / Orientation: layer/gap/coax/spherical/arbitrary 3D dielectric region with interface normal and nearby conductors
records.Compatible Region Roles: REG-C↔REG-REF; REG-C↔REG-SEED; insulation between any energized regions
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: deposit/cure dielectric before later conductor only if surface/process compatibility and damage envelope pass; reverse order is separately resolved
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: voids, moisture, contamination, cure shrinkage, later machining or metal deposition can change field/capacitance; preserve thickness and separation
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF exact ε and geometry/state are attributable. Parallel plate C/A=ε0εr/d only in uniform-field regime; coax/spherical use their laws; arbitrary 3D uses field/Maxwell matrix
records.Verification / Falsifier: capacitance, loss/leakage, dimensional/void inspection and field comparison; no destructive withstand implied
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: electrostatic FEM/BEM/Maxwell capacitance matrix with mesh/domain convergence
records.Notes: Kapton HN candidate ideal C/A remains ≈1.2041695 pF/mm² at 25 µm and ≈0.6020848 pF/mm² at 50 µm; breakdown/lifetime/certification separate.

records.Transferred Flux / Quantity: heat rate Qdot / heat flux q''
records.Boundary / Jump Law: ΔT = q''·R''th or ΔT=Qdot·Rth when a lumped thermal-contact model is valid; otherwise enforce energy balance and solve conduction/contact field
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: thermal contact resistance/conductance; material k; area; pressure/bond state; interface material; T range; radiation/convection if consequential
records.Geometry / Orientation: bonded/contact face, TIM layer, constriction area, local normal, adjacent spreading volume
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: bond/print interface in sequence that preserves wetting/flatness/contact pressure; later encapsulation may improve or worsen path and must be resolved
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: delamination, voids, oxidation, creep, pump-out, strain and aging can change Rth; preserve thermal path and sensor access
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF Rth/R''th or interface materials/contact state are attributable/measured and lumped assumption is valid
records.Verification / Falsifier: temperature drop/IR/embedded sensor response, power balance and thermal cycling; falsify energy residual or hotspot
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: 3D conjugate heat-transfer/contact FE with measured boundary coefficients
records.Notes: Bulk k does not determine contact resistance by itself.

records.Boundary / Jump Law: traction equilibrium across bonded interface; displacement continuity for ideal bond. If linear compliant layer is justified, displacement jump Δu = Cint·t
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: bond/adhesive modulus/toughness/strength; thickness; cure; surface prep; geometry; residual stress; temperature; loading regime
records.Geometry / Orientation: bond face/interlayer/fiber-lattice transition; local normal/tangent and moment arm
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: surface prep→deposit/bond→cure under qualified conditions; X→Y only if successor thermal/chemical load stays within prior bond envelope
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: cure shrinkage, thermal mismatch, moisture, fatigue and later machining may crack/debond; preserve datum and inspectability
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF interface constitutive/strength data and exact geometry/process are attributable in valid regime; otherwise SYMBOLIC/HOLD
records.Verification / Falsifier: lap/peel/shear or application witness, dimensional/strain readback, acoustic/visual inspection; falsify debond/slip/residual
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: cohesive-zone/contact FE or measured interface law
records.Notes: No universal bond strength; exact surface/process state governs.

records.Boundary / Jump Law: nonpenetration/contact complementarity g_n≥0, p_n≥0, g_n·p_n=0; friction law only when coefficient/model is attributable and regime-valid
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: surface geometry/roughness; friction/wear model; preload; materials/coatings; lubrication; T; contamination
records.Geometry / Orientation: bearing/slider/flexure stop/mate faces with contact normals and clearance
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: machine/print clearance and surface finish must be achieved before mating; subsequent coating/fill cannot consume required gap
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: wear debris, creep, swelling, thermal expansion and coating thickness can jam or loosen interface
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF exact contact/friction model and geometry/load state are attributable; otherwise contact state stays symbolic
records.Verification / Falsifier: force/displacement, backlash/friction/wear/clearance test; falsify stick-slip/jam/excess play
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: nonlinear contact FE/multibody/tribology model with measured parameters
records.Notes: Useful for embedded mechanisms; printed geometry alone does not establish lifetime.

records.Conjugate State / Potential: pressure p; chemical potential/concentration where needed
records.Boundary / Jump Law: mass conservation across port; Δp=f(Q,geometry,fluid,regime). Linear Δp=Rh·Q only in validated linear/laminar regime
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: fluid ρ/μ/EOS; port geometry; roughness; regime; inlet/outlet state; temperature; orientation/gravity only when consequential
records.Geometry / Orientation: channel-port/nozzle/manifold connection with flow direction and seal geometry
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: print/open channels before seal/closure; X→Y sequence must preserve cleanliness and cross-section; reverse route separately qualified
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: debris, cure flash, swelling, roughness, misregistration or seal squeeze may change area/loss; inspect before irreversible closure
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF fluid properties/regime/geometry/boundaries attributable and chosen relation is valid
records.Verification / Falsifier: pressure-flow/leak/visualization and mass balance; falsify conservation or pressure-loss residual
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: general 3D CFD / compressible/multiphase solve with mesh/conservation convergence
records.Notes: Pressure rating and pump curve require separate evidence.

records.Boundary / Jump Law: leak/permeation is source/model specific; steady permeation may scale with P·A·Δdriving/L only when its units/model apply. Hermetic state is never inferred from geometry alone
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: seal material/permeability or measured leak; seam/penetration geometry; cure; surface prep; T/RH/pressure; aging
records.Geometry / Orientation: seam, O-ring/gasket, overmold, weld/bond, feedthrough penetration and closure path
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: seal after internal processes only when outgassing/cleanliness/thermal compatibility pass; any penetration reopens containment gate
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: later drilling, fasteners, thermal cycling, strain or chemical exposure may breach seal; preserve witness/inspection route
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF permeability/leak model or measured leak data and exact seal state are attributable; HERMETIC requires applicable measured/source evidence
records.Verification / Falsifier: leak/permeation/pressure-decay/helium or application-specific test; falsify containment residual
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: measured leak model, diffusion FE, or facility-standard hermetic test as applicable
records.Evidence State: HOLD UNTIL EXACT SEAL EVIDENCE / PHYSICAL_NOT_RUN
records.Notes: No hermeticity or pressure authority from printed closure geometry.

records.Conjugate State / Potential: species concentration c or chemical potential μ
records.Boundary / Jump Law: Fick form J=-D∇c when dilute diffusion model valid; interface partition/reaction law must be exact. More general chemical-potential/kinetic model when required
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: D/permeability/partition/reaction constants; chemistry; temperature; concentration/activity; interface condition; material compatibility
records.Geometry / Orientation: coating/membrane/reaction layer/electrolyte boundary with thickness, area and orientation
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: deposit/activate chemical layer under controlled atmosphere/cleanliness; encapsulate only after reaction/cure/offgas state allows
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: cross-contamination, oxidation, solvent attack, moisture, diffusion into prior layers and cure chemistry must be bounded
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF chemistry/model constants, state and geometry are attributable and regime-valid; otherwise HOLD
records.Verification / Falsifier: mass uptake/release, concentration profile, spectroscopy/chemistry-specific assay, coupon compatibility; falsify mass/kinetic residual
records.Notes: Recovered/circular feed must pass identity/contamination/process gates before this operator is enabled.

records.Transferred Flux / Quantity: optical power/field amplitude; photon flux where appropriate
records.Boundary / Jump Law: Maxwell tangential-field boundary conditions govern; Fresnel coefficients only for planar homogeneous/isotropic interface under their assumptions
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: complex refractive index n(λ,T), absorption/scattering, surface roughness, layer geometry, polarization, incidence angle, wavelength
records.Geometry / Orientation: planar/curved optical boundary, waveguide/cladding, coating stack, reflector/absorber surface
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: surface finish/deposit/order must preserve optical constants and roughness; later encapsulation may change index/loading
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: scratches, contamination, cure shrinkage, birefringence, temperature and aging can change phase/loss/coupling
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF optical constants, geometry and regime are attributable; Fresnel/thin-film closed forms only where valid
records.Verification / Falsifier: spectral transmission/reflection/loss/coupling and alignment; falsify power/phase residual
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: full-wave optical / transfer-matrix / mode solve with measured material data
records.Notes: Optical geometry does not establish emitter/detector performance.

records.Transferred Flux / Quantity: magnetic flux Φ/B; surface current relation
records.Boundary / Jump Law: normal B is continuous across ordinary interface; tangential H jump equals surface current density. Reluctance/air-gap lumped law only when magnetic-circuit approximation is valid
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: μ(B,f,T), conductivity/eddy loss, geometry/gap, magnet/core state, current/source, hysteresis if consequential
records.Geometry / Orientation: core-air/core-core/magnet-gap interface, return path, shielding boundary with orientation
records.Compatible Region Roles: REG-LRF↔magnetic material; actuator coil↔core/gap; sensor↔field path
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: place/print magnetic material and gap while preserving geometry/orientation; later metal may add eddy paths or shunts
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: gap change, cracking, saturation, thermal drift, demagnetization and adjacent conductor changes must trigger re-resolution
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF material state/geometry/regime are attributable and approximation valid
records.Verification / Falsifier: B/H/inductance/force or field-map readback; falsify flux/energy residual
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: magnetostatic/eddy/full EM FE with nonlinear material curve
records.Notes: No force or current rating inferred from geometry alone.

records.Conjugate State / Potential: port voltage/current or incident wave a
records.Boundary / Jump Law: linear calibrated/modelled multiport may use b=S·a or V=Z·I; transmission-line continuity only in valid mode/regime; discontinuities require field solve
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: port definition/reference impedance; S/Z/Y data; material ε/μ/σ(f); geometry; fixture/environment; frequency/power regime
records.Geometry / Orientation: feed transition, connector, via, ground/reference, antenna/waveguide interface with port plane and orientation
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: freeze port/reference geometry after conductor/dielectric sequence; encapsulation/nearby bodies require recharacterization
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: misregistration, dielectric change, ground discontinuity, nearby metal/body, connector strain and temperature can detune interface
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF port/network is linear in declared regime and S/Z/Y or exact field model is attributable/calibrated
records.Verification / Falsifier: VNA S-parameters/impedance/coupling and fixture readback; falsify mismatch/residual beyond uncertainty
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: full-wave Maxwell port solve or measured multiport network
records.Notes: P3 passive RF derives from measured P2 L/C where applicable; no biological/natural-frequency target.

records.Conjugate State / Potential: potential difference/common-mode state across isolated domains
records.Transferred Flux / Quantity: intended signal/power coupling plus parasitic displacement/common-mode current
records.Boundary / Jump Law: intended transformer/capacitive/optical coupling uses exact device/model; parasitic C may use electrostatic field/Maxwell matrix. Isolation barrier withstand is separate certified/measured evidence
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: exact isolator/barrier/device; geometry; ε; creepage/clearance where applicable; common-mode dV/dt; frequency; contamination/environment
records.Geometry / Orientation: separation barrier, slot, dielectric volume, transformer/coupler or certified seed package
records.Compatible Region Roles: REG-SAFE/REG-BARRIER between power/control domains; seed↔seed across isolated partition
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: form barrier/keepout before conductors and inserts when required; no later process may bridge, contaminate or reduce separation
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: moisture, contamination, conductive residue, voids, machining and service changes may reduce isolation; inspect after consequential transitions
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF parasitic coupling geometry/material is attributable; certified working/surge/withstand ratings only from exact certified source/test evidence
records.Verification / Falsifier: capacitance/leakage, common-mode coupling, inspection and applicable isolation tests; no destructive test implied
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: electrostatic/full-wave field solve plus exact isolator safety model
records.Notes: Printed surrounding geometry cannot inherit isolator safety rating.

records.Conjugate State / Potential: mechanical displacement/velocity/traction; pressure; electric field for piezo
records.Boundary / Jump Law: mechanical traction/velocity or acoustic pressure/normal-velocity continuity as topology requires; piezo constitutive coupling uses exact tensors/orientation. Impedance matching only with attributable acoustic impedances
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: density, elastic/piezo/dielectric tensors, damping/Q, acoustic impedance, geometry, orientation, bonding/loading, frequency/T
records.Geometry / Orientation: transducer-face/backing/fluid/cavity/bond interface with crystal axes and wave normal
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: bond/cure/load transducer without changing orientation, residual stress or acoustic path outside envelope
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: bond thickness, preload, cure shrinkage, fluid loading, temperature and encapsulation can shift modes/Q
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF exact tensors/orientation/boundaries and mode regime are attributable; precision resonators remain seed/hybrid unless process qualified
records.Verification / Falsifier: impedance/admittance, resonance/Q, displacement/pressure/mode readback; falsify transfer/modal residual
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: coupled piezo-elastodynamic/acoustic FE with calibrated fixture
records.Notes: No resonant efficacy or precision resonator fabrication claim from generic geometry.

records.Transferred Flux / Quantity: mechanical/electrical/fluid connection state and service action
records.Boundary / Jump Law: discrete connection graph + collision/clearance/tolerance constraints; electrical/fluid subinterfaces invoke their own IFK operators
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: connector/fastener/tool envelope; tolerance stack; mate cycles; seal/contact data; service access; contamination state
records.Geometry / Orientation: removal path, keyed connector, fastener, service corridor and keepout volume
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: reserve and preserve service path before irreversible fill/encapsulation; X→Y must not consume required removal/tool envelope
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: wear, debris, stripped fasteners, seal replacement, cable strain and later overmold can invalidate serviceability
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC_IF geometry/tolerances/mate limits are attributable; otherwise symbolic connectivity/keepout
records.Verification / Falsifier: assembly/disassembly mock-up, collision/readback, connector/seal/contact retest; falsify inability to remove/recalibrate
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: configuration-space/kinematic model plus child interface tests
records.Notes: Serviceability is a functional volume, not unused space.

records.Transferred Flux / Quantity: information transfer/read success; no physical continuum flux required
records.Boundary / Jump Law: discrete rule: physical marker/tag resolves exactly one object; expected source/configuration hash must equal observed/resolved hash before state transition. Coupling/readability physics uses optical/RF child IFK when relevant
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: object ID, revision, immutable manifest hash/reference, marker/tag geometry/source, reader, expected/observed hashes, lease/authority state
records.Geometry / Orientation: protected marker/tag/read region with line-of-sight/coupling/service constraints
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: create identity before irreversible encapsulation when reader requires access; preserve marker or redundant pointer through later layers
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: coating, abrasion, contamination, electromagnetic shielding, replacement and revision changes may make identity ambiguous/stale
records.Numeric Inference Gate: NUMERIC only for physical readability/coupling metrics; identity/authority is discrete and evidence-bound
records.Verification / Falsifier: read marker/tag→resolve one object→hash match→DBR receipt; falsify ambiguity, mismatch or unreadability
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: alternate redundant marker/contact/tag route with same immutable identity policy
records.Notes: Identity success never transfers execution, certification or release authority.

records.Conjugate State / Potential: deterministic mode/fault/interlock state; bounded physical state variables
records.Transferred Flux / Quantity: permission/inhibit/trip/reset signals plus isolated energy/mass paths
records.Boundary / Jump Law: no universal scalar law: deterministic state-machine guard + exact source-rated physical isolation/containment constraints. Unsafe or unresolved state forces HOLD/inhibit.
records.Required Source / Measured Inputs: hazard analysis; exact safety devices/materials; interlock logic; energy/stored-energy paths; isolation/barrier data; fault thresholds; reset conditions; applicable standards/evidence
records.Geometry / Orientation: fault zones, barriers, vents, grounds/returns, interlock path, sensor/actuator and service boundaries
records.Compatible Region Roles: REG-SAFE between hazardous process/power/motion/pressure/chemical volumes and C0/control/service domains
records.X→Y Formation / Directionality Rule: safe-state architecture is established before hazardous process enable; no compiler/scheduler transition may bypass interlock/barrier inspection
records.Process / Damage / Preservation Gate: single-fault/common-cause, welded contact, sensor loss, software fault, barrier damage, stored energy, thermal/pressure escalation must fail closed
records.4D State / History Variables: safe/unsafe/latched/test/reset state, fault history, energy state, sensor health, maintenance history
records.Numeric Inference Gate: HOLD unless complete applicable safety architecture and exact evidence are bound; source component ratings do not create system PL/SIL/certification
records.Verification / Falsifier: fault injection where safe/approved, interlock/continuity/containment tests and deterministic state readback; falsify any unsafe transition
records.Fallback / Higher-Fidelity Route: formal/state-machine analysis + domain hazard models + independent safety review
records.Notes: C0 deterministic safety remains separate from C1/C2 cognition and from BUILD_READY classification.
